items.text: **Welcome to the great Copilot Chat journey: Use case of the week!**

Welcome back to our 'Use case of the week' series.

This week, we’ll use Copilot Chat to turn raw numbers into clear insights you can share with stakeholders.

**No theory - just practical examples you can try immediately and see the difference in your daily work.**

body.text:
**SCENARIO DESCRIPTION**

This use case demonstrates how to use Copilot Chat to analyze a dataset (Excel export, CSV, or KPI table) and produce:
- Key trends and anomalies
- Top drivers and hypotheses
- A short executive summary
- Suggested next actions

You’ll upload the file (or paste a table), ask Copilot to summarize patterns, then generate a stakeholder-ready narrative.

**PROMPTS USED**

items.text: [✨ *Analyze the attached dataset. Identify 5 key trends, 3 anomalies/outliers, and what might be driving them. If assumptions are needed, list them clearly.*](https://m365.cloud.microsoft/chat/entity1-d870f6cd-4aa5-4d42-9626-)

[✨ *Create an executive summary (max 120 words) explaining what changed, why it matters, and what we should do next.*](https://m365.cloud.microsoft/chat/entity1-d870f6cd-4aa5-4d42-9626-)

[✨ *Draft a stakeholder email explaining the results in plain language, with 3 bullets and a short ‘recommended actions’ section.*](https://m365.cloud.microsoft/chat/entity1-d870f6cd-4aa5-4d42-9626-)

[✨ *Suggest 5 follow-up analyses or questions I should investigate next (e.g., segmentation, time comparisons, channel breakdown). Prioritize by impact.*](https://m365.cloud.microsoft/chat/entity1-d870f6cd-4aa5-4d42-9626-)
